explanations.text: #$b# is missing from the translation. It starts a new dialogue box; without it the game still moves long text into extra boxes. {{ name }} appears 1 time in the translation instead of 2. The game shows nothing in its place. Fine if intended.
#$b# is missing from the translation. It starts a new dialogue box; without it the game still moves long text into extra boxes. Fine if intended.
[#] is missing from the translation. The letter title would show at the end of the letter text. Fine if intended.

{{Preis}} is not in the English text. The game would show it as raw text.
{1} is not in the English text. The game has no value for it, so the text breaks.
[FarmName] is missing from the translation. The game would not insert this value. Fine if intended.
The player name @ is missing from the translation. Fine if intended.
%revealtaste:Haley:(O)221 is missing from the translation. The gift-taste reveal would not happen.
$1 metHarvey# is missing from the translation. The game needs it to run the dialogue (answers, flags, or events).
The portrait $s is not in the English text: one dialogue box now has two different portraits, so the second shows as raw text.
#$b$ is missing from the translation. The game does not read it as a command and shows it as text, as in the English text. Fine if intended.
#$e# is missing from the translation. The game shows nothing for it, but like a bare # it ends the conversation there and the rest shows the next time. Fine if intended.
{0} is missing from the translation. The game shows nothing in its place. Fine if intended.
{1} is not in the English text. The game has no value for it, so the text breaks.
[ArticleFor apple] is missing from the translation. Other languages have no a/an article here anyway. Fine if intended.
[articlefor Apfel] is not in the English text. The game puts no article here in other languages. Fine if intended.
%action AddMoney 500 %% is missing from the translation. The attached item or reward would not be given.
%item object 128 1 %% is not in the English text. It adds an item or reward the English mail does not give.
%fork is missing from the translation. The event choice would not happen.
%revealtaste is not in the English text. It reveals a gift taste the English text does not.
$k is missing from the translation. The game would show it as text or change the dialogue flow.
The portrait $8 is missing from the translation: the character shows a different face. Fine if intended.
}$ is missing from the translation. The English text has a broken he/she switch here; without it the text shows correctly. Fine if intended.
${ is missing from the translation. The English text has a broken he/she switch here; without it the text shows correctly. Fine if intended.
#$h$ is missing from the translation. The game would show it as raw text or misread the line.
[#] is missing from the translation. The letter title would show at the end of the letter text. Fine if intended.
[#] is not in the English text. Text after it would become the letter title.

The portrait $s is missing from the translation: the character shows a different face. Fine if intended. The portrait $u is not in the English text: one dialogue box now has two different portraits, so the second shows as raw text.
^ is not in the English text. In dialogue, ^ splits the text into male and female versions; in a letter it is a line break. Fine if intended.
# is not in the English text. In dialogue, # ends the conversation there and the rest shows the next time the player talks to the character; elsewhere it is plain text. Fine if intended.
A single { is not in the English text. In dialogue it joins the next box to this one. Fine if intended.
_ appears 3 times in the translation instead of 4. It separates the question, answers, and replies of a quick question; with a different count the game cannot read the dialogue and shows only "...".
* is missing from the translation. In a quick-question reply it starts a new dialogue box. Fine if intended.
A he/she switch needs two or three variants separated by ^, like ${he^she}$, and cannot contain another switch.

#$y is missing from the translation. It starts the quick question in a new dialogue box; without it the game shows the command as text. $y is not in the English text. The game would show it as text or change the dialogue flow.
%spouse is missing from the translation. The game puts the spouse's name here. Fine if intended.
%noturn is missing from the translation. At a festival it keeps the character from turning to face the player. Fine if intended.
%farm is not in the English text. The game puts the farm's name here. Fine if intended.

#$b# is missing from the translation. It starts a new dialogue box; without it the game still moves long text into extra boxes. Fine if intended. The text contains full-width ＄＃ where the English text has $ #. The game shows them as they are; use the normal characters.
The player name @ is missing from the translation. Fine if intended. The text contains full-width ＠ where the English text has @. The game shows them as they are; use the normal characters.
The player name @ is missing from the translation. Fine if intended.

[FarmName] is missing from the translation. The game would not insert this value. Fine if intended. The text contains full-width ［］ where the English text has [ ]. The game shows them as they are; use the normal characters.
